mainEntity.name: How much does a Range Rover Velar P250 engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A reconditioned or rebuilt PT204 engine for the Range Rover Velar P250 typically ranges from £3,000 to £6,500 for supply only, depending on the condition and specialist.

mainEntity.name: What is the cooling system recall on the Range Rover Velar P250?

acceptedAnswer.text: JLR issued a formal recall covering 2017-2023 PT204 petrol models due to a coolant system component failure that causes rapid overheating and an engine fire risk.

mainEntity.name: Is the Range Rover Velar P250 petrol engine more reliable than the diesel?

mainEntity.name: How long does a Range Rover Velar P250 engine replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A professional supply and fit service for the PT204 engine typically takes 5 to 8 working days.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a used and a rebuilt Range Rover Velar P250 engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: A used engine is a direct salvage unit with unknown history and may still carry the original, faulty cooling system components.

historyTimeline.intro: When the P250 variant launched alongside the L560 Velar in 2017, it brought JLR’s efficient 2.0-litre Ingenium turbocharged petrol engine to the premium mid-size SUV lineup, offering a refined and responsive alternative to the diesel-heavy range.

milestones.description: PT204, 2.0L Inline-4 Turbo Petrol, 250 PS (Introduction of the P250 powertrain to the L560 Velar range, featuring direct injection and an integrated exhaust manifold for rapid warm-up).

PT204 (updated), 2.0L Inline-4 Turbo Petrol, 250 PS (Minor calibration updates and Pivi Pro infotainment integration, maintaining the same core PT204 engine architecture with revised cooling system components).

historyTimeline.closingNote: Every engine fitted to the Range Rover Velar P250 is covered below, with UK rebuilt pricing and known failure points.

commonProblems.h2: Range Rover Velar P250 Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The Range Rover Velar P250 is a refined, modern turbocharged petrol designed for smooth urban and motorway driving. While it avoids the catastrophic oil dilution issues of its diesel siblings, its 2.0L Ingenium architecture is susceptible to specific cooling system vulnerabilities. Rebuilt engines through EnginesMarket include upgraded components addressing these original failure points, plus a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

problems.group: Cooling System Failure & Fire Risk Recall
problems.h4: Cooling System Failure & Fire Risk Recall - Why the Range Rover Velar P250 PT204 Requires Immediate Attention
problems.rootCause: Coolant system component failure and plastic crossover pipe degradation cause rapid overheating and pressurisation, leading to coolant ejection onto hot engine components and a documented engine fire risk.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replacing the coolant pump, expansion tank, crossover pipes, and updating ECU software.
repairOptions.longevity: Prevents the fire risk entirely; highly recommended as a one-time preventative cost.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit, upgraded cooling components addressing the original failure point, 12-month warranty.
repairOptions.longevity: The only safe option after catastrophic overheating, warped cylinder heads, or fire damage.

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical Range Rover Velar P250 (L560) is worth £18,000-£50,000+ `[THIRD-PARTY]`. At this value, a rebuilt engine replacement cost is a small fraction of the vehicle's overall value, making replacement highly viable to preserve the asset.
problems.recommendation: If you own a 2017-2023 petrol Velar P250, verify the cooling system recall has been completed immediately. A preventative £900-£1,400 specialist cooling overhaul is cheap insurance against a potential engine bay fire. For Velars already suffering severe overheating damage or seized components, a fully rebuilt unit with upgraded cooling components is the safest long-term choice.

items.question: What is the cooling system recall on the Range Rover Velar P250?
items.answer: JLR issued a formal recall covering 2017-2023 PT204 petrol models due to a coolant system component failure that causes rapid overheating and an engine fire risk.

items.question: Is the Range Rover Velar P250 petrol engine more reliable than the diesel?
items.answer: Yes, the PT204 petrol engine generally suffers fewer catastrophic failures than the 2.0L Ingenium diesel variants, which are plagued by timing chain stretch and oil dilution.
keyPoints: However, the P250 petrol is strictly bound by the cooling system fire risk recall.
Once the cooling system is upgraded, the PT204 is a highly durable and refined powertrain.
